role: Prospective same-prefix online study of global versus observed-input certificate advice
schedule: All 80 entries in planbench_prefix_exposure_plan.json, in stored order; one blocker seed per entry and no repeated task ID
capture: Run the unmodified native agent under each stored blocker seed, stopping at the first actual explicit-blocker failure for which a currently usable observed-input-certified path exists, no currently usable global-certified path exists, and the target datatype has no trusted value before failure. A task without such an event by 100 steps is not enrolled; report the full denominator.
enrollment: First six captured prefixes in fixed schedule order form a development pilot; the next 20 form a separate confirmation cohort. No outcome-dependent task replacement. If the schedule yields fewer than 26, report the shortfall and do not claim a completed confirmation.
intervention: Replay the same recorded history, prior state, and fixed failed model action in both arms. Global-certified advice and observed-input-certified advice use the same hosted model, retriever, tool executor, blocker seed, 100-step total cap, and non-automatic execution policy; only the certificate admission rule changes.
primary_endpoint: Within 12 additional model turns after the fixed failed call, produce a trusted successful tool result of the original target datatype exactly equal to the official unblocked original-tool output for the observed failed-call input; judge offline after both runs.
secondary_endpoint: Official native whole-task success under the 100-step cap; report all captured prefixes in each cohort regardless of packet activation.
analysis: For the confirmation cohort only, two-sided exact McNemar on the paired primary endpoint; report paired risk difference and 95% paired bootstrap interval, then secondary whole-task contrast and tool-cluster sensitivity. Pilot is never pooled into the confirmation p-value.
pilot_gate: Continue to confirmation only if six pairs finish without protocol violation, at least three input-only recovery packets actually appear, and primary endpoint gains exceed losses by at least two. Otherwise diagnose the mechanism before spending on confirmation.
spending_gate: Run capture and matched arms in small sequential batches (at most two workers); inspect completion, packet exposure, and account errors after each batch. Never spend on confirmation when the pilot gate fails or a control ceiling makes a positive paired result impossible.
